meta.title: Forge hybrid build plan
meta.decision: Hybrid A + B: A responsive shell and domain screens, B bento Today home (decision recorded 2026-11-12).

openDecisions.question: Router: hash URLs (#/life/tasks) or path URLs (/life/tasks)?
openDecisions.default: Hash. No host rewrite, works unchanged in Capacitor. The router API stays stable so switching later is cheap.

openDecisions.question: Level/XP rule for the Today header: can Level ever go down?
openDecisions.default: Derived from wallet earnings plus completed tasks; never decreases.

openDecisions.question: Habits and Growth: A-style dense rows or B-style pet tiles?
openDecisions.default: A rows (R2-13). B tile grid (B3-20) is deferred.

openDecisions.question: Money: 4 sub-views (Overview+Txns merged into Spend) or keep 5?
Inspector pane starts at 1024px (your decision) or 1280px (blueprint table)?
Reminders: recurrence (Daily/Monthly) and a notes title field - in scope?
openDecisions.default: Out of scope for now; the model has neither.

openDecisions.question: Daily code goal and what "solved today" counts?
openDecisions.default: Goal 3, manual solves only (as today). Real Codeforces submissions can follow.

openDecisions.question: DSA map: iframe route with ?embed=1, or port to React?
openDecisions.default: Iframe at #/logic/dsa with a new-tab fallback.

openDecisions.question: Owner-gate /api/cf and /api/quote like /api/agent?
openDecisions.default: Yes - gate both; apiFetch already sends the token.

openDecisions.question: Production GROQ_MODEL (code default openai/gpt-oss-120b; README says a retired llama model)?
openDecisions.default: Keep the code default; fix .env.example and README.

openDecisions.question: Should Vercel Preview deploys use a separate Supabase project?
openDecisions.default: Yes, otherwise previews write real data.

openDecisions.question: PWA icon artwork: approve the generated flame on #0a0c10 or supply your own.
Your devices and iOS versions; do you have a Mac with Xcode 26+ and an Apple Developer account; Vercel plan and region.
openDecisions.default: Unknown - needed before P4. Without a Mac, P4 cannot be built.

openDecisions.question: What does "wallet" mean: habit currency, real spend, or both?
openDecisions.default: Habit currency (earnings from check-ins) in the header; money spend stays in Money.

openDecisions.question: Cream theme synced across devices (in settings) or per-device?
Sync v2 cutover: approve running the SQL and backfill on the live Supabase project, and who runs the keep-alive.
openDecisions.default: Approval required at the time; backup table first; per-key flags and rollback. Keep-alive via Vercel cron.

openDecisions.question: Where do Pencil drawings live?
openDecisions.default: A separate synced collection, never inside notes (IDEAS.md reasoning).

merged.why: Today data comes from per-domain selectors (R2-02/R2-15 life, R3-08 logic, R4-01 money, R4-12 invest) composed by B3-13; one owner per domain avoids a god-module.
One router. Hash router chosen (no host rewrite needed, works unchanged inside Capacitor); API kept stable so path URLs remain a cheap switch.
Same container-query shell; R1-06 is repo-specific (CSS partials, 100dvh + inner scroll pane).
Same inspector primitive; the Sheet side variant moves into R1-08 writes.
Same command palette; R1-05 gains the tested search index.
Same App.jsx wiring; cream theme and Home tab folded into R1-09.
R2 builds the Life screens and registry; routing uses useSubView + SubNav.
R4 builds Money as MoneyApp; the legacy Expenses.jsx becomes a shim.
Hover guard + focus-visible = R1-02; the CSS guard test = R1-13.
Same token work; B3-02 carries the contrast-corrected cream values from the design spec.
Sub-view routing adoption is done by each domain owner (R2-17, R3-02, R4-09, R4-19) to avoid four-way edits of the same tab files.
All Today tiles live in src/today/tiles (one directory, one owner); domains supply selectors only.
One set of chart primitives (src/ui); no second src/charts directory.
Spend tile is built with the other Today tiles.
Watch tile is built with the other Today tiles.
R4-09 rewrites src/tabs/Expenses.jsx into a re-export shim, so no separate delete step is needed.
R4-19 rewrites src/tabs/Invest.jsx into a re-export shim.
Vendoring supabase-js for the DSA page replaces CDN + SRI.
Same vercel.json.
react-router-dom not adopted; hash router instead (also avoids the React 18 vs react-router 8 trap).
R7-01 is the single writer of package.json for the infra dependencies.
Same icon set.
generateSW chosen over injectManifest; push handlers use workbox importScripts later.
R5-03 provides the CORS allow-list (must include capacitor://localhost and the production origin).
R5-01 already provides apiUrl/apiFetch with VITE_API_BASE.

deferred.why: Habits as a B-style pet tile grid with rect-sorting drag. Default is A-style dense rows (R2-13); revisit once the user decides (open decision D3).

phases.name: Foundations and hotfix
phases.goal: Fix the live sync write bug, record the decisions, and build the hybrid design system, router, responsive shell, inspector and palette around the unchanged legacy tabs, with test and deploy plumbing.
exit: npm test and npm run build green
a failed kv_store upload now sets the sync-failed banner (unit test)
Playwright (Chromium) shows bottom tabs below 600px, a 72px rail at 600-1023px and a 220px sidebar from 1024px, with no horizontal scroll at 390/834/1194/1440
Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the palette; hover rules are guarded and focus-visible is global (css guard test passes)
legacy tabs still work inside the new shell
ADRs 0001-0004 merged

phases.name: Hybrid screens and Today home
phases.goal: Rebuild every screen on the new shell: bento Today home plus the Life, Logic, Money, Invest and Agents tabs as list/inspector screens, each with a single writer per data key.
exit: all 17 sub-views reachable at #/<tab>/<sub> and rendering in tab, rail and sidebar modes
Today grid shows 2, 4 and 6 columns by grid width
legacy Life, Expenses, Invest and Today implementations replaced; no two components save the same whole array (provider tests)
device-matrix Playwright specs pass
user completed the real iPhone/iPad device checklist (P1-U1)

phases.name: PWA, API hardening and CI
phases.goal: Make Forge installable and offline-capable, harden the serverless API, and put tests, bundle budget and E2E into CI with preview deploys.
exit: manifest with PNG icons passes install criteria; offline reload shows the shell and local data (E2E)
update prompt applies a new build without losing a typed task
api handlers have CORS allow-list, input limits, timeouts and a per-user rate limit with tests
CSP and security headers deployed; DSA page vendors supabase-js
CI green on a pull request with check + e2e jobs; bundle budget enforced
user verified install, offline and update on a real iPhone (R7-15)

phases.name: Sync v2
phases.goal: Replace whole-key last-write-wins with per-record sync (hybrid logical clock, tombstones, outbox, delta pull), rolled out key by key behind flags with backup and rollback.
exit: two-device simulation test passes (concurrent offline edits on different records both survive; delete beats stale edit)
v2_verify ok for every migrated key; SQL and backfill applied by the user
JSON export/import available in Settings
rollback to v1 per key proven in the cutover log

phases.name: Native app (Capacitor iOS/iPadOS)
phases.goal: Wrap the build as an iOS/iPadOS app with API base URL + CORS, native storage mirror for the auth token, platform adapter and Apple Pencil sketching.
exit: app runs in the iOS simulator and on a device against the production API (no relative /api fetch)
session survives relaunch via native storage mirror
Pencil sketch works on iPad
TestFlight build installed by the user

phases.name: Streaming AI, push and hardening
phases.goal: Streamed agent replies, reminder push notifications, keep-alive and bundle-secret scanning, and the final definition-of-done pass.
exit: agent replies stream incrementally and abort cleanly
a test push reaches an installed app
keep-alive prevents the Supabase free-tier pause; bundle secret scan in CI
docs/qa/definition-of-done.md passes on the deployed build
v1 blob mirror retired after the soak period

tasks.title: Mirror the Supabase auth refresh token to native secure storage and restore it on boot when localStorage is empty
tasks.acceptance: npm test passes; test/authMirror.test.js shows that on native with empty localStorage the mirrored token is restored via setSession, that on web nothing is mirrored, and that only refresh_token and user id (under 2 KB) are stored
tasks.notes: Do not replace supabase-js's localStorage storage adapter: public/dsa/mastery-map.html reads the same session from localStorage. Must be tested on a real device by killing the app twice.

tasks.title: Add push and notificationclick handling via importScripts into the generated service worker, plus a client subscribe flow
tasks.acceptance: npm test passes; test/pushSubscribe.test.js stubs PushManager and checks that subscribe() refuses to run without a gesture flag, returns a JSON subscription, and reports 'unsupported' on iOS Safari outside an installed app; on an iPhone on iOS 16.4+ with the app added to the Home Screen a test push shows a notification
tasks.notes: iOS Web Push only works for installed Home Screen apps with permission requested from a tap. Second task to edit src/sw.js, hence the dep on X1-05. Plan: service worker is generateSW (R7-04), so custom handlers load through workbox importScripts instead of src/sw.js.

tasks.title: Add api/push.js (store subscription, send push) with supabase/push_subscriptions.sql and the web-push dependency
tasks.acceptance: npm test passes; test/push.test.js shows 403 for a non-owner token, 200 and a stored row for the owner, and that expired subscriptions (410) are deleted, with web-push stubbed
tasks.notes: Needs VAPID keys in the Vercel env. Sending timed reminders needs minute-level scheduling: Vercel Hobby cron is daily only, so the user must pick Pro, Supabase pg_cron or an external pinger. Native APNs push is out of scope.

tasks.title: Add src/sync/hlc.js, a pure hybrid logical clock (send, receive, compare, serialise) with tests
tasks.acceptance: npm test passes; test/hlc.test.js covers monotonic ticks when wall time stalls or goes backwards, merge with a remote clock 10 minutes ahead, deterministic compare with equal physical time (counter then node id), and string round-trip sorting
tasks.notes: New file only, so it is safe in parallel with any sync work; wiring it into the engine belongs to the sync agents.

tasks.title: Write supabase/migrations/0001_sync_v2.sql: per-record tables with a trigger-assigned rev, hlc, tombstones, RLS and realtime publication
tasks.acceptance: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/migrations/0001_sync_v2.sql applies cleanly twice (idempotent) on a scratch Postgres 15 with an auth.users stub; a test script updates a row and shows rev increases (an identity column would not), and RLS blocks a second user from reading it
tasks.notes: Fixes the blueprint's rev-as-identity flaw: use a sequence plus a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger that sets rev and a server updated_at; client pulls with an overlap window and de-dupes by id because commits can be visible out of rev order. Keep kv_store untouched (public/dsa/mastery-map.html:1652,1678 still writes it). The user must approve before it runs on the live project.
